title: The Porch Light Flickers
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Charlie checks ignore Flashlights — only Fire counts as a light source. DARE: the first player to Gather at a house today may take 3 resources instead of 1 — and lose 2 Sanity from what they see through the window.

title: Shadows Move Without Bodies
immediate: Each player rolls the Sanity d8 and loses Sanity equal to half (round up).

title: Food Goes Bad
immediate: Each player discards 1 Provisions from their resources.
ongoing: DARE: eat it anyway — keep your spoiled Provisions and eat it now: +2 Hunger and -1 Health.

title: A Basketball Bounces in the Dark
immediate: Something is wrong at the School. The top Threat card is placed FACE-DOWN at the Basketball Court. It resolves when someone goes to look — or at the next Dawn where it stands.
art_notes: A ball bouncing in a moonlit empty court

title: Everyone's Hungrier Than They Should Be
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Rest restores no Hunger.

title: The Deerclops Approaches
immediate: Pre-warning. The Deerclops boss arrives next Dawn at the Basketball Court.

title: The Deerclops Arrives
immediate: Place the Deerclops standee on the Basketball Court.
ongoing: While Deerclops is on the map: All Sanity costs are doubled. It festers Doom +2 each Dawn.

title: A Door Opens by Itself
immediate: The player at Ellie & Luca's House loses 2 Sanity. (If empty: skip.)
